qualityGate.goal: photorealistic at close-up product photography distance
qualityGate.workflow: photoscan/photogrammetry -> cleanup -> retopology -> UV -> bake -> PBR/SSS -> GLB

fruit.strawberry.label: Erdbeere
fruit.strawberry.sourceStrategy: CC0 photoscan master; preferred benchmark is the 2.7M triangle CC0 Fragaria x ananassa scan by ffish.asia/floraZia

material.notes: Preserve seed pits, seeds, calyx thickness, red/yellow hue variation and moist specular breakup; never globally oversaturate.

filling.vanilla.label: Vanillecreme
filling.vanilla.sourceStrategy: bespoke sculpt/scan-derived cream surface; displacement from real whipped/butter cream photography

material.notes: Ivory rather than pure white; spatula ridges, tiny air pockets, compressed edge and slight translucency.

dough.vanilla.label: Vanille-Biskuit
dough.vanilla.sourceStrategy: bespoke macro-photogrammetry/material capture from a real baked sponge cross-section

material.notes: Open crumb with non-repeating pores, golden baked rim, moist interior and torn micro-crumb silhouette.

acceptance: pores vary in size and depth

dough.chocolate.label: Schoko-Biskuit
dough.chocolate.sourceStrategy: bespoke macro-photogrammetry/material capture from real chocolate sponge cross-section

material.notes: Deep cocoa brown with warm variation; irregular pores and crumbs; avoid flat near-black albedo.

acceptance: cocoa color variation survives neutral lighting
